title: rust/lichen-core loadng.rs must mirror python discovery.py behavior changes (hop-limit reject, proxy-hint downgrade, RREP forward gates)
description: FIX-A changed python/src/lichen/loadng/discovery.py: hop_limit>4 typed reject, proxy-flagged RREPs are non-installing hints (bootstrap-only), RREP seen-window + freshness-gated forwarding. rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs mirrors this logic per original design; without mirroring, interop vectors will drift across implementations. Derive expected behaviors from spec/appendix-loadng.md + updated python module docstring; extend shared vectors where behavior is now pinned.
